props.gloss_en: one may not light with impure tevel on a weekday
similarly, one may not light with white naphtha on a weekday
white naphtha is understood: [it is forbidden] because it is volatile

Scripture speaks of two terumot: one pure teruma and one impure teruma
pure teruma -- you have [a right] in it only from the time of separation onward
so too impure teruma -- you have [a right] in it only from the time of separation onward
